description: Free, no sign-in: fetch a public page as a first-time visitor and report which trackers (GA4, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, TikTok, LinkedIn, Hotjar…) and cookies load before the visitor consents, which ones wait, which other sites the page contacts (e.g. Google Fonts), and how to fix it. Static check of the HTML and headers (no JavaScript runs). Limited to 10 checks per hour per visitor.

url.description: Public page to check, e.g. https://example.com

name: pre_consent_scan
title: Check what loads before consent (free)
